announcements.headline: Results of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a scheduled annual general meeting, which typically involves routine governance matters such as director reappointments and auditor approvals. It signifies standard shareholder engagement rather than any material change to the company's strategic or financial position.
